content.text: [Discord #code-review eve Tue Mar 12 09:00 EST 2026] Update: I also found out-of-range pickup years in the raw extracts — e.g. 2088 and 2084. The BOT summary missed these entirely. Please add a timestamp valid-year rule and recount anomalies.

Acknowledged. I will add a tpep_pickup_datetime valid-year rule (2009–2024) per the updated quality_rules and produce a timestamp_anomaly_count, keeping passenger_count null_count consistent with the authoritative 1,309,356.
